actions.reason: Keep a small mutation-safe recent-list decode cache on RegexTokenizer and validate cached BasicTokenizer/RegexTokenizer list decodes with dictionary snapshots instead of rebuilding item tuples before returning. This preserves the existing content checks while avoiding repeated dense lookup setup and tuple construction for repeated list decodes.

--- a/minbpe/basic.py
+++ b/minbpe/basic.py
@@ -76,6 +76,10 @@ class BasicTokenizer(Tokenizer):
         # given ids (list of integers), return Python string
         vocab = self.vocab

+        if isinstance(ids, list):
+            cached_last = getattr(self, "_decode_last_list_cache", None)
+            if cached_last is not None and ids == cached_last[1] and vocab == cached_last[0]:
+                return cached_last[2]
         if len(vocab) and max(vocab) == len(vocab) - 1 and isinstance(ids, (list, tuple)):
             vocab_items = tuple(vocab.items())
